# Vũ Hoàng Phương (Phuong Vu Hoang)

> Design Manager and creative lead in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. 10+ years from graphic design to creative direction across brand identity, key visuals, events, photo and video, UI design and AI-assisted workflows. Portfolio: https://phuongvhapple.github.io/

Contact: phuongvh.apple@gmail.com · +84 986 362 186 · Ho Chi Minh City

## Professional summary

I’m a Design Manager leading creative teams of up to 10 people. I build structured workflows that actually ship—balancing clear KPIs, smart resource allocation, and consistent brand quality in fast-moving corporate environments.

I stay hands-on. When timelines get tight or bandwidth runs low, I jump straight into the work to clear bottlenecks and keep quality high without burning out the team.

I treat visual storytelling as a business tool, translating marketing briefs into cohesive visual systems that stay true to brand strategy across digital, print, and live touchpoints.

Beyond brand and campaign work, I design web and app interfaces in Figma—building clean layouts, reusable components, and digital products that feel unmistakably on-brand.

AI is part of my everyday toolkit, from concepting and image generation to video editing and production automation. I work across Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini depending on the task, constantly testing new tools to help my team move faster without compromising craft.

At a glance: Experience 10+ years Graphic design to creative direction Team size Up to 10 Design, photo, video, events, digital Senior Design Officer at Dai-ichi Life Vietnam. Previously Sunrise Events Vietnam, CEN Group, Banyan Tree Group, Nam Long and Thien Minh Group.

## Experience

### Senior Design Officer, Dai-ichi Life Vietnam (2022 – Present)

Brand consistency, rebrand rollout, and multimedia campaign visuals tied to business strategy.

- Translate marketing initiatives and brand positioning into campaign key visuals and multimedia assets.
- Rolled out the Daiichi Life Việt Nam rebrand across digital touchpoints, including the customer portal (kh.daiichilife.com.vn), social campaigns, and instructional videos.
- Direct external vendors and agencies to maintain brand standards and production quality.
- Partner with internal and external stakeholders to align execution plans and present creative concepts.

### Creative Manager, Sunrise Events Vietnam (2019 – 2022)

End-to-end event branding and race-day visual direction for Vietnam’s largest endurance sports events.

- Built and refreshed brand identities for IRONMAN Vietnam, Techcombank HCMC International Marathon, Sunrise Sprint, and LANDMARK 81 “Race to the Summit.”
- Directed race-day photography and videography teams to capture high-impact event coverage.
- Designed comprehensive on-site event visuals, wayfinding, and digital assets (including the HCMC Marathon landing page UI in Figma).
- Managed production vendors and pitched creative directions directly to sponsors and clients.

### Creative Manager, CEN Group, Rising Star Media (2018 – 2019)

Design leadership across client branding, digital campaigns, events, and merchandise.

- Created new brand identities and campaign key visuals tailored to client marketing strategies.
- Led cross-channel design execution spanning digital platforms, event production, merchandise, and marketing collateral.
- Managed external suppliers and presented finished creative concepts to clients and leadership.

### Creative Manager, Laguna Lăng Cô, Banyan Tree Group (2018)

Led the resort’s graphic design team and digital asset library under Banyan Tree brand standards.

- Managed Laguna Lăng Cô’s central digital library (photography, video, web, and PR assets) and unified the resort’s visual identity.
- Led, mentored, and delegated workloads across the in-house graphic design team to hit deadlines and budgets.
- Directed layouts, print collateral, brochures, and campaign visuals strictly aligned with Banyan Tree Hotels & Resorts Corporate Identity Guidelines.
- Acted as primary creative contact across resort departments, translating business briefs into targeted hospitality campaigns.

### Creative Leader, Nam Long Investment Corporation (2016 – 2018)

Corporate design lead covering real estate project branding and company-wide events.

- Developed new brand identities and key visuals for Nam Long’s real estate projects.
- Led visual design and production support for corporate and investor events.
- Directed external agencies and printers, owning quality from concept through final delivery.

### Senior Designer, Thien Minh Hospitality (Thien Minh Group) (2013 – 2016)

Team lead for a multi-brand hospitality, cruise, aviation, and OTA portfolio.

- Led a team of designers across Victoria Hotels & Resorts (8 resorts, cruises, coach, and express train), EMM Hotel & Resorts, L'Azalee Cruise, Lady Hau Cruise, iVivu, and Hai Au Aviation.
- Produced sketches, storyboards, and visual concepts, guiding projects from rough ideas to final print and digital rollout.
- Coordinated across marketing and operations teams to keep multi-channel brand assets cohesive.

### Senior Designer, Innovo Joint-Stock Company (2012 – 2013)

Print and digital marketing collateral for agency clients and the Citypass Guide.

- Designed print and digital marketing campaigns for agency clients and the Citypass Guide publication.
- Collaborated with account teams and clients to adapt creative concepts across multiple media channels.

### Advertising Planning Specialist, Sun Flower Media (2010 – 2012)

Editorial design for leading lifestyle magazines and brand launch support for Tiep Thi Food.

- Designed editorial layouts and advertising visuals for Tiếp Thị Gia Đình, Cosmopolitan, and Her World.
- Supported advertising campaign planning—aligning audience targeting, tone, and messaging while managing production timelines.
- Contributed to the core launch team for Tiep Thi Food, a gourmet retail concept.

## About

Open, energetic, and grounded in logic. Clear structure and disciplined time management are how I keep complex, multi-stakeholder projects moving smoothly.

High-trust and outcome-driven. I work comfortably with minimal supervision and focus on guiding multidisciplinary teams—across design, photo, video, events, and digital—toward clear goals.

Curious by nature and quick to adopt new tools. I treat AI as a practical amplifier in a modern creative workflow, while keeping brand taste, judgement, and the final call firmly with the designer.

Skills: Creative direction, Brand identity, Key visual concepts, UI design, Event design, Photo & video direction, AI-assisted workflows, Team leadership, Presenting & training, Negotiation.
